notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/535f9adf5379ec6c66b6371d623c2a632ed7b9bb.jpg

"Wind Story"It is a simulation leisure business game. The unique HD-2D pixel style brings a fresh and refreshing visual experience, and adding a wish list is not to be missed.
 Steam Link 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/c0380a0ded07a101da55679fbd22ec438a5d568a.jpg

Upon arriving at Wind Chime Ranch, players can immerse themselves in rural lifestyles, including farming, breeding, and fishing. During the day, they can freely roam the Ranch's flower fields, while at night, they can enjoy drinking and dancing by the lakeside bonfire. Players can attract more visitors to the ranch, gradually building their own accommodations, windmills, power houses, and restaurants. They can cultivate a variety of vegetables, flowers, and fruits, and raise diverse animals. Furthermore, they can install various amusement facilities on the ranch to earn more money and create their own recreational oasis.

notes.title: Wild Legion is available NOW!
notes.content:
Hi!

🥳 Wild Legion is released!

💸 $2.99 with -10% launch discount!

Get a grab of the bundles for a cheaper price 👀

~Foreword~

▫️ We, the Blusped studios, are determined to support Wild Legion for the next several months. It is a passion project that we worked on in our spare time for the last year. First of all, we will keep polishing the game. Second, we want to add more content based on the feedback we receive. We also want to do the modding part, but it is an SSS rank idea for the unforeseeable future for now.

notes.title: Our gamedev journey - story of an indie game developers of Wild Legion
notes.content:
Hello!
I am XiaoRui, the lead designer.

Wild Legion is releasing on Jan 26th [strike](or depending on your location on 25th)[/strike]

We want to introduce ourselves, the developers behind the game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/56ed9ca2c7afbcf760270b687133b9c1d1cebeba.jpg

About 10 years ago, we started to code. Originally, we developed relatively professional software, and our clients included internationally renowned electronics corps. But we are gamers. So, we started to create games in our spare time. 


We do hope that one day our games will be recognized and liked. Of course, this is difficult.


In 2013, we released a space shooter on IOS in China, no promotion. For one night, we got to be China #1 free game. This made us jump out of joy.


Then we proceeded to release our passion projects one after another, never spending a day on promotion. Just drop them onto the platforms. The results were as expected. But being a small indie dev releasing a game is already a big thing for us as it is.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/6b9f7bab00de859c983b1f58d987e55bdeaaf8b3.gif


All in all, we have released around 20 games, PC and mobile. We even have an app to record sightseeings of wild animals.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/14ea99d89a476ec64208e2e778d761f74b8d04a2.png

Recent Games

Our SanDream was the first relative success. It entered China's renowned game awards and participated in big events, including the Korean BIC.


We shoot Erabit an email with a publishing request. And they replied. During our time working together, we learned a lot of publishing skills and met many new people, both online and offline.

Our Wild Legion is releasing on January 26. We hope you could try it out :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2359760/Wild_Legion/

notes.title: Release Date Announcement - January 26th
notes.content:
Last month, we changed many things mentioned to us by GRound beta testers. Some content was already implemented in the demo; some content will be revealed later this week.

Changes already implemented
New Music
 New longer Lounge Menu Music
 5 New Music Tracks inside the game
We tried to find pleasant, cozy retro game music with permission to stream on YouTube and Twitch. Each time you start the game, a new music track will play. We hope you like it as much as we did.
Total UI Overhaul
Liya and Erabit created new home screen and UI background images. We re-assigned the buttons and toggled the colors a bit. Here is Before and After:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/e6e89f42fe2ceae0060510272f70a85ee7033071.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/717a69169ac264f8e7b9345a19a1d915bb0bf1e4.png

90+ Achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/3f9cd035880508779a3a230e9455929143ce0878.png
Currently, there are 56 Achievements in the testing.
We want players to explore the game on their own, without pesky tutorial pop-ups obstructing their journey. This is a simple, survival-like game. The Achievements would guide you to explore all content if you desire to do so.
Hints on upcoming content

 More animals
 More night siege maps
 Modding support

More in the content roadmap soon...

notes.title: Change of gameplay direction. Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
MORE SURVIVAL GAMEPLAY - Days & Nights
🌞 Collect resources by day{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/d53841306bd80e7b8b64f9e057f6b71caa66dbc8.gif
🌜 Build Towers by night{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/04349eb52348bd7d853be7fbf67fcf55eb4c29f1.gif

We went to move more "Don't Starve"-like survivor gameplay. New day-night cycle affect the pace of the gameplay. This was something players on expo in Chengdu asked.

More resources appear during the day. Collect them to prepare for the night!
Orcs will try to prevent you from succeeing this mission.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/3598520898beed6b12e2cd573034ae04e4705f31.png

At night the moonlight tower appears. Build a base around to protect her!
Orcs will target the central tower, protect it but don't die!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/495a0865a57704e9eb541f7da5d2612f8464d8a1.png

ONCE YOURS OR TOWERS HEALTH TO ZERO — GAMEOVER

Take Towers you WANT
Only resources for the towers you choose will appear. It will make tower unpgrades more controlled.

When you want more towers:
Main Menu >> Upgrade >> Tower >> BUY BUY BUY
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/a7a9d816d8cb3b1bb75878ed3ed4cdb2514809d4.png

PLEASE TRY THE NEW DEMO
